ينحجب (form VII)
# يَنْحَجِبُ (yanḥajibu) /jan.ħa.d͡ʒi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# يَنْحَجِبَ (yanḥajiba) /jan.ħa.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# يَنْحَجِبْ (yanḥajib) /jan.ħa.d͡ʒib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
